question: How does awareness return to its own mass-like nature after congealing into body and world?
premises: Awareness congeals and takes on the form of body, senses, and known objects.
By the proper method, that congealed state dissolves.
When dissolved, awareness becomes its own dense mass of consciousness.
inference: Awareness that has congealed into body, senses, and objects returns, through dissolution, to its own dense conscious nature.
plain_english: For awareness, having congealed and taken on the form of its own awareness, body, senses, and objects, returns by the proper method—once that state has dissolved—to its own dense body of consciousness.
